summary: Master Excel with our Advanced Dashboards Training Course. Learn to create dynamic, interactive dashboards that enhance data visualization and decision-making.
lede: Excel dashboard training shows analysts and reporting professionals how to turn data from multiple sources into interactive reports. You’ll use Power Query to clean and combine data, build relational models and DAX measures with Power Pivot, and create dashboards with dynamic formulas, interactive controls, and specialized charts. The syllabus also covers automating repeatable tasks with basic VBA and presenting insights clearly.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically engineered for professionals who are responsible for high-stakes reporting and data-driven strategy within their organizations.
modules: Data Architecture and Power Query ETL
Data Modeling with Power Pivot and DAX
Dynamic Arrays and Advanced Formula Logic
Interactive UI Design and User Experience
Automation with VBA and Office Scripts
prerequisites: Participants should have a strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel®, including familiarity with PivotTables and basic logical functions (IF, SUMIFS). No prior experience with Power Query, DAX, or VBA is required, though a basic understanding of data structures is beneficial. A laptop with Microsoft 365 or Excel 2019/2021 (Windows version) is required for the hands-on exercises.
